# The Valley Desk

> A concise, cited record of how healthcare technology, AI, health policy, interoperability, EHR changes, cybersecurity, and related developments affect Delaware Valley health systems.

The site is an aggregator with context, not a magazine. Each published item links to its source material. Use the canonical pages and machine-readable feeds below.

## Sections

- [News](https://the-valley-desk.clyons.workers.dev/news): health-system technology, policy, finance, AI, EHR, interoperability, workforce, and cybersecurity briefs.
- [Events](https://the-valley-desk.clyons.workers.dev/events): confirmed Delaware Valley chapter events, webinars, and regionally relevant programs with registration links.
- [Voices](https://the-valley-desk.clyons.workers.dev/voices): attributed statements from regional health-system leaders and official institutional accounts.

## Machine-readable feeds

- [JSON feed](https://the-valley-desk.clyons.workers.dev/feed.json)
- [XML feed](https://the-valley-desk.clyons.workers.dev/feed.xml)
- [Sitemap](https://the-valley-desk.clyons.workers.dev/sitemap.xml)

## Editorial notes

- Prefer the primary source and citations attached to each item.
- Dates and event times use the America/New_York timezone unless the item states otherwise.
- Unpublished and review-queue material is not part of the public record.
